title: Toolshop registration and invoices: valid registration, invoice detail header and line items (P1 cases from docs/test-cases.md with no known defect; disposable customers, invoices created through the API)

scenarios.title: Valid submission creates the account and redirects to login

steps.action: Open the registration page (#/auth/register) as an anonymous visitor
Fill every registration field with valid values (a unique email) and click Register
expected: The user is redirected to the login page
The new account exists and can be used to sign in

externalReferences.system: upstream user story v5: User Registration

scenarios.title: Invoice detail shows number, date and total

steps.action: Register a new customer account through the API (disposable account owned by this case)
Create an invoice for that customer through the API (one line item of a seeded product, quantity 2)
Sign in as that customer in the browser
Open the invoices list (#/account/invoices) and click Details of the invoice
expected: The invoice detail shows the invoice number
The invoice detail shows the invoice date
The invoice detail shows the invoice total

scenarios.title: Line items show quantity, name, price and line total

steps.action: Register a new customer account through the API (disposable account owned by this case)
Create an invoice for that customer through the API (one line item of a seeded product, quantity 2)
Sign in as that customer in the browser
Open the invoices list (#/account/invoices) and click Details of the invoice
expected: The invoice detail lists the line item with its quantity
The invoice detail lists the line item with its product name
The invoice detail lists the line item with its price
The invoice detail lists the line item with its line total
